text: At a March 14 meeting in West Quay, Varnholt Logistics named Dorian Feltz its new chief executive, the company confirmed to the Gazette. Board chair Lena Voss said the appointment took effect immediately after a unanimous vote by directors. I saw Feltz arrive later that morning at the firm’s riverfront depot, where staff lined the loading bay for a brief introduction. He told employees he would focus on delivery times, fuel costs and “steady growth without layoffs.” Varnholt, which runs freight routes across the Baywater district, reported turnover of 18.6 million crowns last year. Feltz succeeds Martin Keene, who left the post in February after four years in charge.
